chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Mufazzal ibn Umar, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Mufazzal! If you want to know whether a man is going towards goodness or towards evil, look at where he places his act of kindness. If he places his act of kindness with its rightful people, then know that he is going towards goodness. And if he places his act of kindness with other than its rightful people, then know that there is no share for him in the Hereafter from the Creator.'

key_terms.مَعْرُوف: Act of kindness or good deed

ai.seo_question: How can one determine if a person is spiritually progressing towards goodness or evil?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links spiritual trajectory to the discernment of *istihqaq* (deservingness), emphasizing that true piety lies in directing kindness to those who merit it rather than for social display. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the inner intention (*ikhlas*) and the social wisdom of recognizing the specific rights and status of others, ensuring that good deeds yield maximum spiritual fruit in the Hereafter.
